newsitem.title: USA: Source Services adopts rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Source Services adopts rights plan.

text.p: Source Services Corp said Friday it had adopted a stockholder rights plan under which preferred stock purchase rights will be distributed on June 18 at the rate of one right for each outstanding share of common stock, to stockholders of record on that date.
Source said the plan was not adopted in response to any specific effort to acquire control of the company, and the board is not aware of any such effort.
The plan is intended to assure that stockholders receive fair treatment in the event of unsolicited attempts to acquire the company. it said.
Each right entitles the holder to buy 0.01 share of a new series of preferred stock at an exercise price of $90, subject to adjustment, Source said.
The company said the rights will be exercisable if a person or group acquires 20 percent or more of the company's common stock or announces a tender offer for 20 percent or more of the common stock.
